traits.name: Multiattack

traits.name: Engulf
traits.summary: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. When the shambling mound moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.

traits.name: Bound
traits.summary: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the shield guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the shield guardian to travel to it, and the shield guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the shield guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the shield guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: The shield guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.summary: A spellcaster who wears the shield guardian's amulet can cause the shield guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the shield guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the shield guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The shield guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.summary: The shield guardian makes two Fist attacks.

traits.name: Protection
traits.summary: Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the shield guardian's amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the shield guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the shield guardian's next turn.

traits.name: Shriek
traits.summary: Trigger: A creature or a source of Bright Light moves within 30 feet of the shrieker fungus. Response: The shrieker fungus emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker fungus dies.

traits.name: Multiattack

traits.name: Cold Breath

traits.name: Paralyzing Breath

Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

traits.name: Slam

traits.name: Divine Awareness

traits.name: Legendary Resistance

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.summary: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

traits.name: Thunderous Bellow
traits.summary: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature and each object that isn’t being worn or carried in a 150-ft. Cone. Failure: 78 (12d12) thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Swallow
traits.summary: Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions and can't teleport, it has Total against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the Prone condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

traits.name: Onslaught
traits.summary: The tarrasque moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.
